chronology: After independent v9 source/trace inspection; before any replacement-tool execution or route implementation.

controls.expect: Direct pinned linkage inspector executes required -L work for all four existing targets; exact linkage expectations retained.
Missing or changed executable bytes/mode/physical route refuse before a target marker; a mere basename match is insufficient.
Unknown executable route and unapproved transitive image/reference refuse admission; no post-execution hash labeled preflight.
DEVELOPER_DIR, TOOLCHAINS, SDKROOT, xcrun cache/selection and loader injections refuse or are explicitly absent in bound child environment; no ambient selector runs.
Actual frozen typing helper reaches direct bound Git for ls-files without body changes; argv, environment and binary identity recorded.
Empty-environment Node/native descendants with a declared absolute route execute real required work; an undeclared default-path fallback cannot silently become accepted.
Existing exact system-reference pairs unchanged; new tool's two pairs require explicit approval; readable replacements or extra/non-system references refuse.
Linkage output changes/missing dependencies are detected; inspection cannot be removed while admission still reports success.
Direct Git ordinary repository/archive work succeeds with fixed identities; no instruction-body checkout/materialization, no private checkout mutation.
No xcodebuild/xcrun/llvm-wrapper selector is admitted as an incidental route; unknown route observation is HOLD, not a new trusted-OS exception.
OS instruction-write profile and descriptor/process/readonly/private fences remain intact; inert symlink references do not imply writable aliases.
All owned children settle/reap; unknown survivors/cleanup or provenance violations yield nonzero/HOLD even if functional output matches.

qualification: Planned route controls only, not twelve safety/product passes. A10 and full-gate execution require the separately applicable authorization. No full-gate release exists for a successor.
